rules.text: Never use an ash toner darker than the achieved underlying level, or hair will absorb excessive green/muddy drabness.
rules.source: Learn card: Level & Tone System

rules.text: When: At consultation to diagnose natural depth and set realistic lift boundaries.
rules.source: Learn card: Level & Tone System

rules.text: For a true level 8 beige from a level 6 base, lift to pale yellow (level 9) and tone back, rather than fighting orange at level 7 with more ash.
rules.source: Learn card: Underlying Pigment & Neutralization

rules.text: When: Whenever lifting hair past natural level to anticipate and neutralize brassiness.
rules.source: Learn card: Underlying Pigment & Neutralization

rules.text: Acidic demi-permanents (e.g. Shades EQ with its Processing Solution) stay on the acid side, so they deposit tone without lifting natural pigment. There is no developer volume to choose.
rules.source: Learn card: Developer Volumes & Hydrogen Peroxide Dynamics

rules.text: When: Selecting oxidation strength for lift vs. deposit-only services.
rules.source: Learn card: Developer Volumes & Hydrogen Peroxide Dynamics

rules.text: Use an equalizing porosity spray or acidic clear glaze as a buffer before running toner through fragile, high-porosity ends.
rules.source: Learn card: Porosity, Cuticle Integrity & Fillers

rules.text: When: When taking over-processed or lightened hair back to darker shades or uneven lengths.
rules.source: Learn card: Porosity, Cuticle Integrity & Fillers

rules.text: Apply to the most resistant grey areas first (usually hairline or temple) and allow full 35-45 minutes processing time without rushing.
rules.source: Learn card: Resistant Grey Hair Coverage Chemistry

rules.text: When: When clients present with >30% unpigmented white hair and coarse cuticles.
rules.source: Learn card: Resistant Grey Hair Coverage Chemistry

rules.text: Use acidic liquid glosses on damp hair after foilayage to guarantee virgin regrowth does not lift or shift brassy.
rules.source: Learn card: Toning & Glazing Science (Acidic vs Alkaline)

rules.text: When: Post-lightening refining, shadow routing, and gloss refreshing.
rules.source: Learn card: Toning & Glazing Science (Acidic vs Alkaline)

rules.topic: Metallic Salts, Henna & Box Dye Incompatibilities
rules.text: If the history is unknown, run the 1:20 test on a cut strand (1 oz 20 vol + 20 drops 28% ammonia, 30 minutes). For box dye, strand test the darkest band and plan the lift around it.
rules.source: Learn card: Metallic Salts, Henna & Box Dye Incompatibilities

rules.topic: Metallic Salts, Henna & Box Dye Incompatibilities
rules.text: When: New client consultation and chemical history intake.
rules.source: Learn card: Metallic Salts, Henna & Box Dye Incompatibilities

rules.text: Never waive patch tests for clients reporting previous tingling, itching, or allergic reactions to hair color or dark cosmetics.
rules.source: Learn card: Strand & Patch Testing Protocols

rules.text: When: 48 hours prior to any oxidative service or when testing chemical tolerance.
rules.source: Learn card: Strand & Patch Testing Protocols

rules.text: A bond builder is not permission to go higher or longer. Follow the maker's dose (some slow the lift), keep the saturation even, and let the strand test decide.
rules.source: Learn card: Bond Builders & Chemical Protection

rules.text: When: During high-lift lightening, platinum transformations, and color corrections.
rules.source: Learn card: Bond Builders & Chemical Protection

rules.text: Instruct clients to wait 48 hours before their first home shampoo and use heat protection below 320°F (160°C) on lightened blondes.
rules.source: Learn card: Post-Color Maintenance & Longevity

rules.text: When: Client checkout, retail recommendation, and aftercare game planning.
rules.source: Learn card: Post-Color Maintenance & Longevity

rules.text: Never lighten over suspected compound henna or metallic salts before a strand test passes.
rules.source: Learn card: Metallic Salts, Henna & Box Dye

rules.text: Don't expect tint to lift artificial colour: use lightener or a colour remover.
rules.source: Learn card: Developer Volumes

rules.text: Don't put more than 20 vol lightener on the scalp.
rules.source: Learn card: Developer Volumes

rules.text: Don't colour a new client or a returning one after 6+ months without a 48 h patch test on file.
rules.source: Learn card: Strand & Patch Tests
